```sql
SELECT e.Name, s.Salary
FROM EMPLOYEES e
JOIN SALARIES s ON s.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
WHERE s.Salary = (
    SELECT MAX(Salary)
    FROM SALARIES
    WHERE Salary < (SELECT MAX(Salary) FROM SALARIES)
);
```
This returns all employees tied at the second-highest distinct salary. If the schema contains multiple salary records per employee, the query should first establish which record represents the current salary.
